They hardly miss: move and take cover.
Cinco bolas en abanico: de cerca no perd: Five balls in a fan: merciless up close, gone by 12 m. Three shots.
Cincuenta bolas de cinta, estable a 45 m: Fifty belt-fed balls, steady at 45 m. Heavy to move and to reload.

Corre entre las barricadas y pinta a tus: Run between the barricades and paint your rivals. Pick teams, lives or capture the flag.
Short and sure: three hits up close. Right click or V throws it in an arc; it is back in your hand 2.5 s later.
Diez bolas por segundo de cerca. Se desv: Ten balls a second up close. It wanders and does not reach far.
El mapa de la esquina muestra lo que tie: The corner map shows what is close to you and your team. A rival only appears for a moment when they fire. Hold Tab to see the whole court.

En bandera gana el equipo que llegue pri: In capture the flag, the first team to reach the room's captures wins; in domination, the team that scores the target points.
En Hardcore un pepazo te saca, pero vuel: In Hardcore one hit knocks you out, but you're back fast with endless lives.
En la armería cada arma tiene su puesto: In the armory every weapon has a spot for the sight, barrel, hopper and stock. The small hopper reloads fast; the big one holds more balls.
En teléfono camina con las flechas y arr: On a phone, walk with the arrows and drag your finger across the screen to look. Hold Paint: the sight sticks to the visible rival in front of you.
Entra en tu cuenta de pana.sh para conse: Sign in to pana.sh to earn it
Ese camuflaje todavía no es tuyo: la sal: That camo isn't yours yet: the room gave you a solid one.
Falta un pana en el otro equipo: The other team needs a player
Francotiradora: a la cabeza saca de una;: Sniper: a headshot knocks out at once; body hits hurt more up close than far away. 70 m of reach. Right click for the scope; without it the shot drifts.
La armería abre entre rondas. En plena r: The armory opens between rounds. Mid-round: 1 and 2 or Q switch weapon; Z and X change model.
The {flag} flag went back to base.
The reliable one. Accurate, steady and light.
La Lejana pinta dos pepazos por tiro, pe: La Lejana lands two hits per shot, but without the scope it drifts. La Bazuca's rocket knocks out at once on a direct hit: aim ahead of your rival.
La más ligera. Rápida y de recarga corta: The lightest one. Fast with a short reload, but short range.
La más rápida: un pepazo por brochazo, t: The fastest: one hit a stroke, three strokes a second.
La ronda online sigue mientras estás en: The online round keeps going while you're in the menu.
La sala no aceptó el kit. Inténtalo otra: The room didn't accept the kit. Try again.
Largo y contundente: tres pepazos por ba: Long and heavy: three hits a swing, four if the tip lands.
Las barricadas frenan las bolas. Tienes: Barricades stop the balls. You have twelve per load; reload with R or automatically when it's empty.
Lento y pesado, el que más lejos llega:: Slow and heavy, the longest reach: three hits and a shove; four with the tip.
Llevas dos armas: el Arma 1 puede ser cu: You carry two weapons: Weapon 1 can be any, Weapon 2 a pistol or a melee weapon. Each keeps its own paintballs; after a switch the new one takes a moment before it fires.
Los bots apuntan fino y no sueltan el ga: The bots aim sharp and never let go of the trigger.
Los bots fallan seguido y disparan menos: The bots miss often and shoot less.
Mantén G para cargar la granada: los pun: Hold G to charge the grenade: the dots show its arc and the ring how far it paints. Look up to throw it higher. The fuse starts when you let go.
Mantén para cargar la granada y suelta p: Hold to charge the grenade, release to throw it
Marcadora (si la sala permite todas): Marker (if the room allows all of them)
Más lenta que La Parrandera, pero más re: Slower than La Parrandera, but straighter, and it reaches 61 m.
Medio pepazo por piedra, pero casi nunca: Half a pepazo per stone, but it almost never runs out. Straight, light and quick to reload.
Mirar y apuntar (haz clic en la cancha p: Look and aim (click the court to capture the mouse)
Modelo anterior o siguiente del arma en: Previous or next model of the weapon in hand
The purchase didn't go through. Try again.
Para todo: cadencia buena, precisa y 48: For everything: good rate of fire, accurate, 48 m of range.
Pinta a tus rivales entre las barricadas: Paint your rivals between the barricades: whoever reaches the round's goal or leads when time runs out wins.
Probar, en la armería, abre el polígono: Try, in the armory, opens the shooting range with your kit: targets from 10 to 100 m, and every hit shows its distance and its pepazos.
Room full. Open another court from Pana.
Seis granadas de pintura seguidas que re: Six paint grenades in a row that burst where they land. Mid range; no sprinting.
Seis tiros de dos pepazos cada uno. Lent: Six shots of two pepazos each. Slow between shots; long reload.
Si estás solo, tres bots entran contigo;: If you're alone, three bots join you; with friends the court is all yours. Pick how many bots play in More settings. You can invite up to eight friends.
Si te pintan en primera persona, miras a: If you get painted in first person, you watch the panas still standing until you're back on the court.
Tirador con mira de 2,2×: un pepazo por: Marksman with a 2.2× scope: one pepazo a shot, faster than La Lejana.
Tres bolas de cerca. De lejos pierde fue: Three balls up close. Loses power at range.
Tu bandera está en el suelo: tócala para: Your flag is on the ground: touch it to return it
Tu equipo es tu clase: Balanceado corre: Your gear is your class: Balanced sprints for longer, Fast runs more and takes less, Tank the opposite, Regen cleans off sooner and when it paints someone, Stealthy is barely heard or seen on the map, Grenadier carries two grenades.
Un chorro de pintura: cada gota es un qu: A stream of paint: each drop is a fifth of a pepazo. Short, slow and almost endless.
Un cohete de pintura, un pepazo por riva: A paint rocket, one hit per rival. Four loads per life; no sprinting.
Un cohete lento que se ve venir. Si pega: A slow rocket you can see coming. A direct hit knocks out at once; it barely splashes. Three per life.
Un pepazo que aturde: el rival queda len: One hit that stuns: the rival is slowed for a second.
Una pintada suma un punto. Gana quien ll: Each splat scores a point. Whoever reaches ten or leads when time runs out wins. With limited lives, the last player or team standing also wins.
Veinte bolas por segundo de medio pepazo: Twenty balls a second, half a pepazo each. Heavy, no sprinting and a long reload.
Ver la tabla y el mapa completo: Show the table and the whole map
Vuelves a la cancha 2,5 segundos después: You return to the court 2.5 seconds after being painted. When you respawn you get 1.5 seconds of protection; shooting cancels it.
Ya es tuyo, pero la sala lo verá cuando: It's yours, but the room will see it when you rejoin: for now you wear a solid one.
